rankingRule: Ranked on one ladder: the last printed sold price of the raw 1st Bowman Chrome Auto, with a 30-day liquidity gate.
callout: Sep 25 board: Gonzales −12.3% to $79.99 on a $67.00 print Sep 24, Fischer’s clock stops on a $144.26 print Sep 23 (+1.0% to $156.13), Holliday and Florentino unchanged with no printed sale since Sep 15 and Sep 17.
signalVocabulary: currentSignal is the board's published call — BUY / HOLD / PASS / WATCH. SELL is the engine's nightly ask-side signal and is never a board call. loggedCall.action is the historical Scorecard call and may differ; the page's current signal always wins.
marksPolicy: Sold comps and asks are separate figures and are never blended. A PSA 10 line states the sale count behind it, or states that there is no verified sale. Calls are graded at 6 and 12 months only.

changeLog.what: Holliday’s $720 PSA 10 was never a PSA 10 sale — and the Sep 17 graded review got the direction wrong on three of the five names.
